meta.title: AntiSismo — Your safety at every step
meta.description: Earthquake alerts, action guides and verified emergency numbers for the Dominican Republic.

nav.sosLabel: Emergency: see the number to call

preview.body: We are building the web platform. Live data, the map and accounts will arrive in the next phases. Meanwhile, the emergency information on this page is already official.

home.lead: Information, alerts and tools to always be prepared.
home.honestyBody: AntiSismo amplifies official alerts and does not replace them. No system can guarantee zero failures. Always follow the instructions of the authorities.

realtime.title: Real-time alerts
realtime.body: Earthquakes and other hazards from official sources, with the source and time of every data point.

maps.title: Vulnerability maps
maps.body: Risk layers for the Dominican Republic and the region.

safeSites.title: Safe sites
safeSites.body: Shelters, hospitals and high ground near you, only with verified data.

multiHazard.title: Multi-hazard in Latin America
multiHazard.body: Clear guides on what to do before, during and after each hazard.

home.benefitsTitle: Benefits for you and your community

emergency.title: Emergencies in the Dominican Republic
emergency.callHint: Your phone will ask you to confirm before calling.
emergency.disclaimer: AntiSismo does not replace official emergency services.

footer.sources: Earthquake data: USGS and EMSC. Tsunami messages: NOAA (tsunami.gov). The source of every data point is always shown.

states.notFoundTitle: We could not find this page
states.notFoundBody: The link may be mistyped or the page may no longer exist.
states.errorBody: We could not load this section. Your emergency information is still available on the home page.

forms.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email, for example name@domain.com.
forms.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again; what you typed will not be lost.
forms.errorSummary: Check the highlighted fields to continue.

strength.label: Password strength: {level}
strength.hint: Use at least {min} characters. A multi-word phrase is easy to remember and hard to guess.
strength.containsEmail: Do not include your email in the password.
strength.common: It contains a very common word.
strength.fewClasses: Mix letters, numbers or symbols, or use a longer phrase.
strength.breachNote: When you submit it, we check anonymously that it does not appear in known breaches (only a fragment of its hash is shared).

register.title: Create account
register.lead: An account is optional: receiving public alerts never requires one. It enables My Family, your emergency plan and managing your devices.
register.termsLabel: I accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
register.termsRequired: You must accept the terms and the privacy policy to create an account.
register.doneBody: If the address {email} can be registered, you will receive a link to confirm it. The link expires and works only once.
register.termsOutdated: The terms were updated while you filled in the form. Review them and accept them again.

verify.title: Confirm email
verify.successBody: Your account is ready. You can now sign in.
verify.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. Request a new one.
verify.resendDone: If the account exists and still needs confirmation, we sent you a new link.

login.title: Sign in
login.notVerified: Confirm your email before signing in.
login.oauthError: We could not complete Google sign-in. Try again or use your email.
login.lockNote: For security, access is paused for a few minutes after several failed attempts.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgot.title: Recover password
forgot.lead: We will send you a link to create a new password.
forgot.doneBody: If an account exists for {email}, you will receive a link to reset your password. It expires soon and works only once.

reset.title: New password
reset.doneBody: For your security we signed you out on all devices. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email or request another one.

guard.expiredBody: What you typed is still on screen. Sign in in another tab and try again.

account.title: My account
account.termsBody: Review the current <terms>Terms of use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy> ({version}) to keep using your account.
account.termsAccepted: Thank you. We recorded your acceptance.

securityPage.title: Account security
securityPage.mfaLead: In addition to your password, a code from an authenticator app will be required.
securityPage.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
securityPage.qrAlt: QR code to set up two-step verification
securityPage.codesLead: Each code works once if you lose your phone. We will not show them again.

sessionsPage.title: Sessions and devices
sessionsPage.lead: These devices have an open session. If you do not recognize one, sign it out and change your password.
sessionsPage.empty: There are no other open sessions.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong email or password, or access is temporarily paused for security.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.BREACHED_PASSWORD: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose another one.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: The link or session is no longer valid.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to respond. Try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some data is not valid. Please review it.
errors.TERMS_OUTDATED: The terms changed. Review the current version.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: The request could not be verified. Reload the page.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable right now. Public alerts and emergency numbers keep working.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.API_NOT_CONFIGURED: Accounts are not available on this deployment. Public alerts and emergency numbers keep working.
